candidate: While you look, notice what your body does and what feelings or urges show up. Is there something that younger you seems to want you to understand? Some of it you'll remember yourself, and some of it you might even glean from talking to family/friends from then ("You hated that coat"). It might just be a guess you're making from the picture, or perhaps it triggers an image or a dream. Or just nothing comes up. Ask what your little one needs from you now, and do a bit of it.

edits.old: an inference you're guessing from the picture
edits.new: a guess you're making from the picture
edits.why: "inference you're guessing" is redundant, since an inference is already a guess. This keeps the same tentative certainty in plainer wording.
